positions.as_written: Order dependence is the standing limitation, and it is larger where structures are adjacent capsular layers.
Examine at full extension and at 20 to 30 degrees deliberately, as a sampling strategy.
Record the angle with any laxity finding.
Read differences between published figures as protocol differences.
Expect order dependence to be worse where the structures are adjacent capsular layers.
Treat the angle dependence as the thing that makes a medial reconstruction a two limb operation and the thing that makes tensioning angles matter.
Measure the postoperative result at both angles, not one.
Expect a single limb construct to leave one angle less controlled.
Accept that a residual laxity cannot be attributed to a specific limb.
